title: Build resume CRUD API routes with tenant scoping
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/tenant/resumes — list all resumes for current tenant (paginated)
GET /api/tenant/resumes/[id] — get single resume with RLS scoping
POST /api/tenant/resumes — create resume record with tenant_id from context
All routes return 404 (not 403) for cross-tenant access attempts
All routes require authentication; unauthenticated requests return 401
